description: Change the signed-in member's alert settings, as on Heed's Settings page: urgent alerts by email, monitor alerts by email, the weekly digest, how often alerts arrive (realtime, daily, weekly) and countries to mute. Send only what changes. Use it for 'stop emailing me about X' or 'send me a weekly digest instead'. Confirm first. Returns every setting as stored.

monitor_email.description: Email for changes Heed only monitors for them.

muted_countries.description: Countries whose changes stay silent, names or codes. Replaces the list.

urgent_email.description: Email when a change marked urgent affects the member.

name: update_notification_preferences
title: Update alert settings
